pullRequests.title: Fix Archipelago RAC1 empty vendor handling for NTSC and PAL
pullRequests.author: SavedbyBlood9
pullRequests.head: fix/archipelago-rac1-empty-vendor
pullRequests.body:
Summary
Fixes vendor behavior in the Ratchet & Clank 1 Archipelago mod for NTSC-U and PAL v2.00.
Changes

Automatically closes the vendor menu after purchasing the final available item, preventing a crash caused by an empty item list.
Prevents interaction with vendors when their Archipelago-filtered stock is empty.
Restores vendor interaction when new items become available.
Adds version-specific memory addresses for NTSC-U and PAL v2.00.

Testing

Tested vendor behavior in NTSC-U.

commits.headline: feat(xbox-icons): Going Commando's discs, one library for both games
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Going Commando keeps Ratchet & Clank's fonts: effect textures 1 to 3,
256 x 128 with one palette, the pad glyphs in the same cells of row 96.
Its effect bank word and texture table per disc (NTSC-U and PAL
0x001B1604 / 0x001B9740, NTSC-U v2.00 0x001B1584 / 0x001B96C0), read
from each boot program's GetEffectTex, SetupGifPaging and level loader,
and the hashes of the four font sets of its levels.

The mod is laid out as docs/MULTI_GAME.md says: src/mod.c picks the
game, src/rac1 and src/rac2…

commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The rac2 strafe, read from its hero code (DESIGN.md), on rac1's hero:

- a Feel setting, Going Commando by default: Hold turns Ratchet to the
  camera instead of swinging the camera, the strafe turns at rac2's rates
  (0.037 / 0.25 / 12.2 rad/s, 0.015 / 0.2 / 15 in the air), a side
  reversal stops him first, the backpedal starts within 45 degrees of
  straight back; Classic keeps 1.0's behaviour;
- the hip twist: the pelvis (joint 1) eases toward the move yaw and the
  first spine joint (2)…

commits.headline: refactor(difficulty): split into common and rac1 for more games
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The mod now follows docs/MULTI_GAME.md: src/mod.cpp hands the load to the
game that loaded it, src/rac1 keeps Ratchet & Clank's hook points, addresses
and classes, and src/common holds what every game shares: the rules, the
moby pool's guard, and a session with the settings, the level's values,
Chaos's events and a party's rules.

The events' clock learns which knobs a game honours and only picks events it
can play; with every knob (rac1) its picks are the same as before for the
same seed.…

commits.headline: feat(difficulty): Going Commando, every slider but the enemy count and speed
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The library now loads in Going Commando on its USA v1.01, PAL and USA v2.00
discs (src/rac2), through rac2 hook points named after rac1's where they do
the same job: rac2.player.take_damage, rac2.combat.get_hit,
rac2.weapon.take_ammo, rac2.moby.record_death, rac2.player.approach_speed,
plus rac2.level.load (the level's load, which rewrites the weapon table's
prices, ammo prices and most ammo from the level's own values),
rac2.player.nanotech_steps (the count the max health is made of)…

commits.headline: fix(difficulty): leave Going Commando's health pickups to the game
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The nanotech orb's update is assembly on the PAL and v2.00 discs and under
one of the port's own wraps, so it is not a hook point on every disc, and a
hook point a mod asks for that the port lacks fails the mod. Health pickups
and the Nanotech surge event are Ratchet & Clank's only for now.

commits.headline: feat(multiplayer): a party's listing names its game
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A game other than Ratchet & Clank adds its id after the mods' digest
("Going Commando|3fa9/rac2"). Ratchet & Clank keeps its untagged and
digest-only parties as its own, marks another game's as differing in
Browse, and leaves one it joined, as for a level that does not agree.

commits.headline: feat(multiplayer): a host's own game can become the party's
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Coop::adopt makes the game a host already plays the party's once it is
in a level: each member comes into it as a late joiner does, and the
host's game stays where it is when the party goes. Coop::barrier turns
off the scene and arrival waits for a game whose pad the mod does not
hold.

commits.headline: feat(multiplayer): co-op in Going Commando, chosen in the settings
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The mod loads in rac2 (NTSC-U, PAL, NTSC-U v2.00) on the port's rac2
play calls, with no hook point and no page: rac2's title has none. The
rac2-only settings party (host, join by code, host directly, join an
address), code and address say what to do; the line over the game and
the log say what happened. The host's game becomes the party's once it
is in a level, members start the host's level from its live save and
follow its travels, and everyone sees the others as figures. Same
server,…

commits.headline: feat(item-randomizer): Going Commando's gadgets, Sheepinator and vendor stock
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: One library for both games: src/mod.c hands the load to Ratchet & Clank's part or to src/rac2, which shuffles Going Commando's gadget places and the Sheepinator with its own logic (planets in the story's order, places' needs after the APRac2 world), and the planets the vendor stocks each weapon from. Givers that test their own item are shown their place's state; Endako's own sets are caught each tick; the places had live in unused progress bytes of the save. NTSC-U v1.01 only for now.

commits.headline: feat(item-randomizer): Going Commando's PAL and USA v2.00 discs
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Each disc's owned and new bytes, vendor table and progress chunk come from a
table (src/rac2/discs2.h): PAL keeps them at 0x1A7B80, 0x1A7BB8, 0x2403C0 and
0x139638, v2.00 at 0x1A7B00, 0x1A7B38, 0x240340 and 0x1395B8, as OpenRAC's
release tables give them and as each disc's copy of Endako's level start
forms them; the vendor table's 16 pairs are the same bytes on each disc. The
seed's tag and bits at chunk 5 + 0xC0 are reached by no code on any disc.
An unknown disc is refused before any hook.…

commits.headline: fix(lock-strafe): turn the hip twist the game's way
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The twist sent the pelvis and spine quaternions with +sin(a/2). Both
games build a turn of a about z with the sine negated (rac1's
build_axis_rotation_quaternion, func_L00_001FFED8; rac2's func_00283898),
since their joint matrices take the rotation's rows as the joint's axes.
With +sin the hips turned away from where Ratchet went: strafing left,
his legs walked forward to the right while he slid left.

rac1_strafe_joint_yaw now builds the game's quaternion. hero_strafe
checks it against rac2's…
